summary: The wave decides it landed a ledger commit by diffing the tip, so a commit landing beside a refused rewrite is reported as this tick's `commitSha`

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: a pick's ledger sha is appended from the fact the rewrite reports about its own call, never from a tip comparison, so none of the three arms that write no commit — footprint already recorded, live foreign tip claim, out-of-tree dock — can contribute a sha to `TickResult.commitSha` or `ledgerCommitShas` whatever moved the tip while the rewrite ran, and the merge stage's three log arms read the same fact
tests: the pending-ledger rewrite names the ledger commit it landed
pins: a wave whose ledger rewrite a live foreign tip claim refused reports no ledger commit
notes: Verified: `src/waveMerge.ts:1064` pushes on `update.sha !== preUpdate`, ahead of the `tipMoved` arm (`:1065`); `preUpdate` is read at `:1030`, so a commit landing between it and the refusal's own revParse (`src/pendingLedger.ts:644`) is appended as this wave's. Three of four returns write no commit — `:616` no-op, `:644` claim, `:664` dock. `sha` (`:495`) is read nowhere but that diff and the same comparison at `:1085`/`:1088`. `tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:9982` is the claim arm's shape.
